description:
As an authenticated SmartGrocer user
  I want AI-powered grocery insights and pantry-based recipes
  So that I never run out of essentials and minimize kitchen waste

elements.name: Fetch AI replenishment predictions

steps.name: I am authenticated as test user "user1@gmail.com"
I request replenishment predictions
the response should contain predicted grocery items
each prediction should include an urgency level and confidence score

elements.name: Request food waste risk analysis

steps.name: I am authenticated as test user "user1@gmail.com"
I request food waste risk analysis
the response should return evaluated pantry waste risks

elements.name: Generate zero-waste Chef Gemini recipes

steps.name: I am authenticated as test user "user1@gmail.com"
I request chef recipes based on current pantry inventory
the response should contain recipes with used pantry items and waste reduction scores

elements.name: Query AI Assistant chatbot with grocery intent

steps.name: I am authenticated as test user "user1@gmail.com"
I send a message "What do I need to buy for dinner?" to the AI Assistant
the assistant reply should be relevant to groceries and food
the response should not be refused

name: AI Recommendations, Replenishment Forecasting, and Chef Gemini APIs

description:
As an authenticated or guest client
  I want to check system health and browse products
  So that I can view available UK groceries

elements.name: Verify backend service health probe

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/health"
the response status code should be 200
the response body should contain status "ok"

elements.name: Retrieve active UK product catalogue

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/products" with query parameters:
the response status code should be 200
the response should contain a list of products
the product count should be at least 1

elements.name: Filter products by search keyword

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/products" with query parameter "search" as "milk"
the response status code should be 200
every returned product name or category should match "milk"

elements.name: Filter products by category

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/products" with query parameter "category" as "Milks"
the response status code should be 200
every returned product category should contain "Milk"

elements.name: Retrieve single product details by valid ID

steps.name: I fetch the first available product ID
I send a GET request to "/products/{productId}"
the response status code should be 200
the product details should match the requested ID

name: Product Catalogue & Backend Health APIs

description:
As an authenticated SmartGrocer user
  I want to track pantry items and log food consumption
  So that I can prevent food waste and review spending analytics

elements.name: Add an item to pantry and query expiring items

steps.name: I am authenticated as test user "user1@gmail.com"
I pick an available product from the catalogue
I add the product to my pantry with expiry date in 3 days
the pantry item should be created successfully
I query expiring pantry items
the response should contain items expiring within 5 days

elements.name: Log food consumption and verify inventory deduction

steps.name: I am authenticated as test user "user1@gmail.com"
I pick an available product from the catalogue
I add the product to my pantry with quantity 2
I log consumption of 1 unit consumed and 1 unit wasted with reason "Expired before use"
the consumption should be recorded with status 201
the analytics summary should reflect total savings and waste avoidance metrics

name: Pantry Expiry Tracking & Waste Analytics APIs

description:
As an authenticated SmartGrocer user
  I want to create and manage shopping lists and estimate my bill
  So that I can stay on budget during my grocery trips

elements.name: Create and fetch user shopping lists

steps.name: I am authenticated as test user "user1@gmail.com"
I send an authenticated POST request to "/shopping-lists" with payload:
the response status code should be 201 or 401
the shopping list name should be "E2E Test Weekly Run" if authenticated
the shopping list budget should be 75 if authenticated

elements.name: Add an item, update quantity, and calculate bill estimate

steps.name: I am authenticated as test user "user1@gmail.com"
I have an active shopping list
I pick an available product from the catalogue
I add the product to the shopping list with quantity 2
the list item should be added successfully
I calculate the bill estimate for the shopping list
the estimate should return a positive total
the estimate should contain budget adherence status

elements.name: Enforce BOLA authorization on list item modification

steps.name: I am authenticated as test user "user1@gmail.com"
I have an active shopping list
an unauthorized user attempts to delete a list item
the API should reject the request with 404 or 401

name: Shopping List Management & Bill Estimation APIs

description:
As a visitor on the SmartGrocer Web App
  I want to see the brand landing page showcasing core features with top sign-in and sign-up buttons
  So that I understand the application and can access my account

elements.name: Render public landing page with core feature showcase

steps.name: I navigate to the SmartGrocer Web App
I should see the "SmartGrocer" branding with Leaf Basket icon
I should see the "Sign In" and "Sign Up" action buttons
I should see the live bill predictor and expiry alerts feature cards

elements.name: Access grocery dashboard via authentication

steps.name: I navigate to the SmartGrocer Web App
I click "Sign In"
I should be able to access the grocery dashboard

name: Web UI Landing Page & Authentication Showcase

description:
As an authenticated SmartGrocer user
  I want to browse and filter 1,000+ UK catalogue items
  So that I can add items to my active shopping list

elements.name: Browse products and filter by category

steps.name: I navigate to the catalogue page
I should see the category filter pills including "Dairy & Eggs"
I select the "Dairy & Eggs" category pill
the displayed product cards should be updated with dairy items

elements.name: Live search and one-click add to cart

steps.name: I navigate to the catalogue page
I search for "bread" in the catalogue search box
the search results should display bread products
I click "+ Add" on the first product card
the button state should update to show the item is in my list

name: Web UI Catalogue Search & Product Filtering

description:
As an authenticated SmartGrocer user
  I want to view zero-waste recipes using my pantry items
  And add missing ingredients directly to my active list

elements.name: Add missing ingredients and remove box from recipe card

steps.name: I navigate to the Chef AI page
I should see recipes with zero-waste scores and used pantry items
I click "Add Missing Ingredients to Shopping List" on an eligible recipe
the missing groceries section should be removed from that recipe card
a confirmation badge "Missing ingredients added" should be displayed

elements.name: Open floating AI Assistant from any screen

steps.name: I navigate to the SmartGrocer Web App
I click the floating "Ask AI" button in the corner
the AI Assistant chat drawer should open with quick prompt suggestions
I select the quick prompt "What do I need to buy?"
the conversation history should display the assistant recommendations

name: Web UI Chef Gemini Recipes & One-Tap Add

description:
As a SmartGrocer household user
  I want to view my pantry inventory with real-time expiry alerts
  So that I can prevent food spoilage and log consumption

elements.name: Viewing pantry inventory and expiry status indicators

steps.name: I navigate to the pantry page
I should see the pantry inventory list with expiry countdown badges
I should see filters for "All", "Expiring Soon", and "Fresh"

elements.name: Filtering pantry items by expiry status

steps.name: I navigate to the pantry page
I click the "Expiring Soon" pantry filter pill
only items with high spoilage risk should be visible

name: Web UI - Pantry Inventory and Expiry Tracking

description:
As an authenticated SmartGrocer user
  I want to review my shopping list, check off items, and track live bill estimates
  So that I know my total cost before checking out

elements.name: Live bill prediction and item management

steps.name: I navigate to the active shopping list page
I should see the Live Bill Predictor with Subtotal and Target Budget
I should see the list items with checkboxes and quantity adjusters
I click the checkbox on the first item
the item should be marked as purchased

elements.name: Complete shopping run and restock pantry

steps.name: I navigate to the active shopping list page
I click "Complete Shopping Run"
the confirmation modal should appear with my actual total
the option to restock pantry should be selected

name: Web UI Shopping List & Bill Predictor
